'''Nate Carr''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 6th at [[April 2001 Lancaster tournament]] on 1 April 2001, according to Geoff Gallo-Cornell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2003">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-02-lancaster-pa-4-2-01d2003/ lancaster-pa-4-2-01], DeckTech (Geoff "Loaf" Gallo-Cornell, 2 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-02-lancaster-pa-4-2-01d2003/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
